name: report-panel
description: Adversarial review panel for long-form Chinese reports written by AI: parallel blind review with a 4-tier verdict, deterministic Python consistency gates, restructure proposals, an appeal channel, and revision regression checks. Delivers findings only — it never edits the manuscript.

description_i18n.en: Adversarial review panel for long-form Chinese reports written by AI: parallel blind review with a 4-tier verdict, deterministic Python consistency gates, restructure proposals, an appeal channel, and revision regression checks. Delivers findings only — it never edits the manuscript.
description_i18n.zh-CN: AI 长报告对抗评审团：多席盲评（四档判定+release_blockers）+ 一致性硬校验（python 确定性门禁）+ 结构重排 + 复议申辩 + 修订回归验证。只出意见不改稿。
